acceptanceCriteria: ci-test-slices accepts a go-product shard log from a current main CI run that contains the AFP-V0-047 shadow summary line
A regression test with that log line fails before the fix
body: Observed by lane ci-waste-1021g (PR #1449, V1-1752) on build 702: feeding current go-product shard logs to the ci-test-slices tool fails at the AFP-V0-047 shadow-selection summary line with 'no Action', so slice tables cannot be regenerated from live CI logs. Expected: the parser skips or understands the shadow summary line and produces slice costs.
title: ci-test-slices refuses current CI shard logs at the AFP-V0-047 shadow summary line ('no Action')
